title: Extended Hold Term Calculation — Homesite Reservation
content:
**Clause.** For an extension of a Homesite Reservation hold, the current hold term is the calendar days from the reservation date to the current hold expiry date. The extended hold term is the current hold term plus the extension length plus the extension early bonus, less the extension letter shortening and less the extension card shortening, all in whole calendar days; where that sum exceeds the extension maximum, the extended hold term is the extension maximum instead, and the extension is written at that term rather than refused. The extension maximum is the extension maximum offset plus the extension maximum level, in whole calendar days, and no part of the extended hold term is rounded.

The extension length is the class's extension days. The extension early bonus, the extension letter shortening and the extension card shortening are each zero days. The extension maximum is counted from the reservation date, so the extension maximum offset is zero, and the extension maximum level is the class's maximum total hold days. The extended hold term is therefore the current hold term plus the class's extension days, and it may not exceed the class's maximum total hold days counted from the reservation date: where the current hold term plus the class's extension days would exceed that figure, the extended hold term is the class's maximum total hold days.

## Input, judgement, output

| Input | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| current hold term plus extension days | is it more than the extension maximum? | if not, that sum is the extended hold term |
| | | if so, the extension maximum is the extended hold term and the extension is still written |

## Worked examples (hypothetical class figures: extension days 6, maximum total hold days 18)

| Reservation date | Current hold expiry date | Current hold term | Sum | Extended hold term | New hold expiry date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 11 June | 10 | 16 | 16 | 17 June |
| 1 June | 16 June | 15 | 21 | 18 (held to the maximum) | 19 June |
